name: 4-PrO-MET
summary: 4-PrO-MET, also known as 4-propionyloxy-N-methyl-N-ethyltryptamine or as O-propionyl-4-HO-MET, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to 4-AcO-DMT (psilacetin). It is thought to be a prodrug of 4-HO-MET (metocin) similarly to 4-AcO-MET (metacetin). 4-PrO-MET was encountered online as a novel designer drug in August or September 2025.

pharmacology.text: It is thought to be a prodrug of 4-HO-MET (metocin) similarly to 4-AcO-MET (metacetin).

uses.text: 4-PrO-MET was encountered online as a novel designer drug in August or September 2025.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Because it is thought to turn into 4-HO-MET in the body, its effects are expected to resemble other psilocin-like tryptamines: nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, such drugs can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。由於一般認為它會在體內轉變成4-HO-MET，預期它的作用會類似其他類脫磷酸裸蓋菇素的色胺：噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，這類藥物可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。由于一般认为它会在体内转变成4-HO-MET，预期它的作用会类似其他类脱磷酸裸盖菇素的色胺：恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，这类药物可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is an ester: the hydroxy group of 4-HO-MET is capped with a propionyl group, which the body is thought to remove to release the active drug.
fact.zh: 它是一種酯：4-HO-MET的羥基被一個丙醯基蓋住，一般認為身體會把這個基團移除，釋放出有活性的藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它是一种酯：4-HO-MET的羟基被一个丙酰基盖住，一般认为身体会把这个基团移除，释放出有活性的药物。
